tables.name: t
tables.columns: k UInt64, u0 UInt64, u1 UInt64, u2 UInt64, u3 UInt64

inserts.insert: INSERT INTO {table} SELECT number * {n} + {i} AS k, sipHash64(k, {seed}) AS u0, u0 % 1000 AS u1, k * 7 AS u2, intDiv(k, 3) AS u3 FROM numbers({rows})

params.query: SELECT sum(u0), sum(u3) FROM {db}.t WHERE k BETWEEN 40000 AND 120000

description: Fit on the narrow shape with Compact parts: restart, a warm pass, then the measured pass of the SELECT touching k, u0 and u3 over four parts.
